newsitem.title: USA: Alcatel unit gets supplier contract.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel unit gets supplier contract.

text.p: A U.S. unit of Alcatel Alsthom said on Wednesday that American MetroComm Corp has selected Alcatel as its sole source supplier of digital cross connects and advanced optical network transport equipment for its telecommunications network.
The total value of this relationship for Alcatel is expected to exceed $30 million, Alcatel said in a statement.

American MetroComm, a local exchange carrier, now has an operational network serving primarily the New Orleans central business district and networks under construction in three other cities, Alcatel said.
